meta.implementation_note: Separate one-off budget (assumption): ~6 engineer-weeks for morning mode (spoiler-free surfaces, timed replay push) and credit-ladder checkout logic (~₹3.6 lakh) plus analytics tooling (~₹0.4 lakh). Included in total programme economics, not in the ₹10 lakh marketing budget.
meta.labels: Every number in this file is a model assumption unless marked case fact or external fact.

tax.note: assumption: displayed consumer prices are inclusive of 18% GST; net sales = price/1.18

variable_costs.note: assumptions; rights fee is fixed and confidential and is excluded (contribution, not profit); no revenue share on pass sales assumed

session_masters_overnight.label: Session pass, Masters/Finals, overnight start (live + 48h replay)

session_model.label: Blended session price used in cohort model

finish_season.label: Finish-the-Season pass (5 Oct-22 Nov 2026: Shanghai, Basel/Vienna, Paris, ATP Finals + all 250s, weekly show, replays)

season_2027_loyalty.label: ATP Season Pass 2027 loyalty price for 2026 season/FTS holders buying by 15 Jan 2027

credit_ladder.session_to_tournament: full session price credited toward the tournament pass of the same tournament, until that tournament's final
credit_ladder.tournament_to_fts: full tournament pass price credited (cap ₹99, one per account) toward the Finish-the-Season pass within 30 days of the tournament purchase
credit_ladder.fts_to_season_2027: not a credit: loyalty price ₹349 instead of ₹399 if bought by 15 Jan 2027
credit_ladder.precedence: exactly one price reduction per checkout: upgrade credit > segment offer > public promo; credits never stack
credit_ladder.arbitrage_checks: 3 cheapest session passes (3x19=57) < tournament floor 59 only for ATP 250 where tournament list is 79; 4 sessions (76) < 79 => cap: session-pass purchases limited to 3 per tournament per account; 2 tournament passes (158-178) < FTS 199 so only 3+ event buyers gain from FTS

cohorts.note: Pathway probabilities for a tournament-pass entrant; repeat+upgrade = 60% base reflects the case's 60-65% repeat-purchase observation (lower bound, window unspecified).

renewal_2027_loyalty.note: assumptions for newly acquired lower-intent cohorts; the case's ~90% season renewal is not applied to them

cohorts.note_2028: case-informed (~90% season renewal, CF7) applied only to customers who already renewed once; 2028 season bought Jan 2028 within the rights horizon

cannibalisation.note_a: share of would-be FTS-direct buyers who enter via a tournament pass and never upgrade
cannibalisation.note_b: share of upgraders who would have bought 3+ tournament passes at full price
cannibalisation.note_c: share of loyalty-price renewers who would have renewed at ₹399

channels.name: Performance prospecting, cold tennis-interest audiences (learning test)
channels.execution: Meta/YouTube video, FTS ₹199 in marquee weeks, geo-split
channels.rule: Stop at day 30 unless attributed CAC < ₹300; shift remainder to C2

channels.name: High-intent search + retargeting at T-48h, new-to-pay tennis intent
channels.persona: P2 (free tennis viewers, tennis-page visitors, lapsed 2025 buyers)
channels.execution: Google search on tennis/live terms; Meta retargeting of tennis page visitors and free-content viewers; control IDs excluded via customer lists
channels.rule: Scale if attributed ≤ ₹200 and incremental ≤ ₹300; pause at ₹250 attributed

channels.name: First-party CRM activation (push, email, in-app) with 10% persistent holdout
channels.persona: P2-free (new payers); P3/P4/P5 (existing payers, first ATP purchase)
channels.execution: Segment-specific pushes at T-48h and 07:00 IST morning replay; suppression after purchase; 3 pushes/week cap
channels.evidence: planning pools are assumptions to be replaced with CRM counts on day 0; rates are assumptions; holdout readout
channels.rule: Keep if measured relative lift ≥ 30%; otherwise fold into C2

channels.name: Tennis communities and contests (e.g., Indian Tennis Daily), pass prizes
channels.execution: 3 contests (Shanghai, Paris, Finals) with pass prizes; creator fees; light boosting
channels.evidence: case CVR 7.8% (CF12); effective CPC is an assumption
channels.rule: Continue only if effective CPC ≤ ₹8.6 (CPC ceiling at 55% new-payer share)

channels.name: Editorial and native tennis personalities (Race to Turin, 20-minute Morning Match cuts, weekly-show tie-ins)
channels.execution: Existing weekly show + 2 editors on event weeks; personality segments; zero incremental rights cost but production costed
channels.rule: Cut if morning-replay open rate < 15% and no next-event return lift

channels.name: ESPN.in takeovers converted to a geo/time-split test (2 marquee weeks)
channels.execution: Takeover live in test cities, held out in matched cities, crossover between Shanghai and Paris weeks
channels.rule: Scale only if geo lift in new payers is positive at p<0.1

channels.name: Retention: morning-replay journey creative, upgrade and renewal communications
channels.execution: Onboarding, post-first-view, pre-next-event, expiry and season-end bridge messages

channels.name: Measurement and analytics (holdout operations, geo design, dashboards, analyst time)

dedup.note: share of C3 (new-payer pool) and C4 conversions assumed also reachable in C2 audiences and removed to avoid double counting
